summary: Verified. The core claims hold: no shared page frame (widths max-w-3xl to max-w-7xl plus InfoPage's nested container, H1 20-56px), every text element in Cal Sans (and only the SemiBold file is loaded, so every weight renders semibold or faux-bold), InfoPage's prose-xl and glass panel on 20 routes, 93-character lesson lines, near-identical lesson H2/H3, and boxed lesson chrome. Corrections: most P1s are really P2 (inconsistent, not broken); the font change is the one site-wide P1. The table of contents is already grouped by layer. The outline quick links are there on purpose below xl, so they should be hidden only from xl. InfoPage is also the only width wrapper on privacy and terms. Tests pin `header h1`, the Breadcrumb nav label and the quick-links list. Added: interview prep is one 76,541px page.
strengths: The learner area (dashboard, assessment, settings) shares one plain header, one pill sub-nav and one max-w-6xl width. It is the most consistent part of the site and the model for a shared PageHeader.

The lesson orientation header shows tier and module, core or elective, reading time, 'Lesson 1 of 1 ... module 1 of 14', the milestone it builds toward and the prerequisites, all in one place (lesson-f1a.desktop.default-dark.s0.png).

The lesson table of contents is already nested under the four layers with EXPERT tags, highlights the active section, and becomes an 'On this page · 27 sections, 6 expert' disclosure below xl (lesson-f1a.1024.default-dark.s0.png).
VisualFrame gives every lesson visual the same eyebrow, title, summary, fidelity badge and 'Assumptions and limits' disclosure.
The four-layer lesson model (Quick Take, Build Your Mental Model, Make It Work, Push Further) is pinned by tests/topicTemplate.spec.ts and serves junior through expert readers.
No page overflows horizontally at 390px (overflowX 0 for every record in metrics.json). Only the 65px header is sticky, and lesson headings use scroll-mt-28.
Module cards carry a code, a time estimate, prerequisites, milestones and labs (curriculum.desktop.default-dark.s1.png).
Interview questions each link the lessons that teach them ('Learn it in' with module codes), and the practice, exercise and lab cards use the same pattern.
proposal:
Build a small set of layout primitives, then move pages onto them in order of how many pages each step fixes.

Primitives:
1. Type and colour tokens. Make `fontFamily.sans` Inter-first and add `fontFamily.display` for Cal Sans (only SemiBold is loaded, so use it for H1/H2 only). Add role tokens in globals.css for every theme (--heading, --text, --text-muted, --link, --emphasis, --status-*), make dark --foreground near-white, and map the typography plugin's prose colours to them. Retire the --blueprint-* tokens and .glass-card as pages move.
2. PageShell({width}): reading max-w-3xl, content max-w-6xl, wide max-w-7xl. Inside MainLayout it adds no extra container or padding. The public privacy and terms pages have no MainLayout container, so they must wrap InfoPage in PageShell themselves.
3. PageHeader({eyebrow, title, lead, breadcrumbs, actions, subnav}): a <header> element (regression-gates.spec.ts and LessonOrientation.test.tsx select `header h1`) with one H1 style (30px on mobile, 36px from sm, display face), a lead capped at 65ch, and no card.
4. Prose: one typography config tied to the tokens, with text children capped near 68ch and figures, tables, code and VisualFrame at full width. Lessons, history and InfoPage use it.
5. Card and Badge as cva components (surface, interactive, inset, callout; code, level, status, filter, count). Keep Button and use it in place of raw primary-button strings.
6. Breadcrumbs: one plain-text chevron trail that keeps `nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"]`, which e2e specs select.

Order:
- Step 1 (M): fonts first (S on its own), then colour roles across all six themes. This lifts every page.
- Step 2 (M): rebuild InfoPage on PageShell, PageHeader and Prose with no glass panel. That fixes 20 learning routes. Update legal-pages.test.tsx.
- Step 3 (M): the lesson shell. Unbox the article, breadcrumbs and orientation (keep the <header>), apply the 68ch measure, style layer H2s with a top rule and more space, and make the TOC layer groups collapsible (they are already grouped).
- Step 4 (M): the learner area as proof, then practice, interview prep (add per-level jump links), knowledge hub, resources, history, placement quiz and 404.
- Step 5 (S): bring the curriculum module list higher, give the lab a compact header, and hide the outline quick links from xl only.
- Step 6 (L, ongoing): move local *Card components and ad-hoc pills onto Card and Badge as each interactive is touched. Add a scripts/ audit that fails when the ad-hoc count rises.
- Step 7 (S): rewrite docs/topic-template.mdx from F1A, keeping the six H2s that tests/topicTemplate.spec.ts requires.

findings.title: All body text, including 8,000-word lessons, is set in a single-weight display face
findings.evidence: tailwind.config.ts:54-59 lists `var(--font-cal-sans)` first in `sans`. fonts.ts:46-51 loads only CalSans-SemiBold.otf with weight 600, and layout.tsx:28 applies `font-sans` to body. metrics.json: body, p, h1, h2 and nav links compute to __calSans on every page. Because only the 600 file exists, text styled w400 renders semibold and w700 headings are faux-bolded. In lesson-f1a.desktop.default-dark.s0.png the running text and the bold run-in terms ('What it is:', 'bug') look almost the same weight. Inter is loaded but used only as a fallback.
findings.impact: Long reading is the main task on this site (F1A has 8,330 words, phasing has 11,088). A semibold display face everywhere flattens emphasis and slows reading for every reader.
findings.fix: In tailwind.config.ts make `sans` Inter-first and add `fontFamily.display: ['var(--font-cal-sans)', ...]`. Apply `font-display` only to H1/H2 (PageHeader, section headings, and `prose-h1:font-display prose-h2:font-display` on the lesson article and InfoPage). Consider dropping Cal Sans preload so only pages that show it pay for it. Re-measure line lengths afterwards, because the measure changes with the face.

findings.title: InfoPage gives 20 learning routes 56px titles, 108-127 character lines and a nested glass panel
findings.where: /exercises and its 4 exercise pages, 12 /practice/visualizations/* pages, /practice/waveform-studio, /projects, /learning-strategies (plus privacy and terms in the public group)
findings.evidence: InfoPage.tsx:20 adds `container mx-auto py-8 px-4` inside MainLayout's own `container mx-auto px-4 ... lg:px-8` (MainLayout.tsx:23). InfoPage.tsx:21 adds `bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-lg border border-white/20`, and :22 adds `prose lg:prose-xl max-w-none`. grep finds 20 learning routes and 2 public pages importing it. Measured on /projects at 1440px: paragraphs at 20px and 108-127 characters per line (extra/layout/extra.out.json 'proj'). metrics.json desktop: H1 56px and H2 36px on exercises, projects, learning-strategies and viz-uvm-phasing, and main text width 1134px. The exercises H2 is `text-primary` (exercises/page.tsx:33), which is blue (#00BFFF) in dark mode and crimson in light mode (exercises.desktop.default-dark.s0.png, extra/layout/exercises.desktop.default-light.s0.png). Mobile main text width is 292px against 358px on the dashboard (metrics mainTextWidth): MainLayout padding, InfoPage padding and panel padding each take 16px a side.
findings.impact: Exercises, every visualization page and the project briefs look like a different product, and their long lines are tiring to read. On phones 66px of width goes to stacked padding.
findings.fix: Rewrite InfoPage as PageShell(content) + PageHeader + Prose (prose-base, text children capped near 68ch). Drop the glass panel and the inner container. The privacy and terms pages have no MainLayout container, so wrap InfoPage there in a width wrapper (or give InfoPage a `standalone` prop) so they do not go full-bleed.

findings.title: Each page type has its own header pattern, width and H1 size
findings.evidence: Page roots each centre their own width with mx-auto: curriculum max-w-7xl (curriculum/page.tsx:41), lesson max-w-6xl (curriculum/[...slug]/page.tsx:106), interview-prep max-w-4xl (interview-prep/page.tsx:213), knowledge-hub max-w-5xl (KnowledgeHubClient.tsx:45), expert-index max-w-5xl (expert-index/page.tsx:124), history max-w-3xl (history/page.tsx:26), resources `container mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4` inside MainLayout's container (resources/page.tsx:26), and InfoPage's nested container. metrics.json desktop default-dark H1 sizes: 20px lab, 30px 404, 36px most pages, 48px curriculum, 56px InfoPage pages, 60px home. Headers range from plain (curriculum, dashboard, resources) to carded (lesson orientation, interview-prep hero) to none (lab). Left content edges differ: compare curriculum, resources, interview-prep and exercises .desktop.default-dark.s0.png (navbar wordmark at x=112, exercises panel at 128, resources at 160, interview prep at 272).
findings.impact: Moving between pages feels like moving between sites. The title jumps in size, colour and position, so the frame does not tell learners what kind of page they are on.
findings.fix: Add PageShell (reading max-w-3xl, content max-w-6xl, wide max-w-7xl, no extra container inside MainLayout) and PageHeader (a <header> with eyebrow, H1 30/36px, lead, actions, sub-nav, breadcrumb slot) in src/components/layout/. Move each page root onto them, starting with InfoPage and the learner area, and remove the inner container in resources/page.tsx:26.

findings.title: Lesson lines run to 93 characters at 1440px
findings.evidence: extra/layout/cpl.out.txt: F1A median 93 and p90 103 characters per line at 1440px, median 77 and p90 91 at 1024px. Phasing p90 86 at 1440px. extra/layout/measure.out.json: the article is 800px wide at 1440px (text 750px), 640px at 1280px and 704px at 1024px. The article is `max-w-none` (curriculum/[...slug]/page.tsx:134) in a grid column that grows with the viewport (:115).
findings.impact: Lines beyond about 75 characters make it harder to find the start of the next line in dense technical prose.
findings.fix: Cap text children of the article near 68ch (`prose-p:max-w-[68ch] prose-li:max-w-[68ch] prose-headings:max-w-[68ch]` or a Prose primitive) and let VisualFrame, tables, pre and figures keep the full width. Re-measure after the font change in layout-3.

findings.title: Lesson layer H2s and section H3s look almost the same
findings.evidence: measure.out.json: H2 24px/700 white with margin-top 0, H3 20px/600 white, same face and colour, and no rule or band on H2. Each lesson has 6 H2 and 35-37 H3 (cpl.out.txt). In lesson-f1a.desktop.default-dark.s2.png 'Build Your Mental Model' and 'Words you will meet' differ only slightly in size.
findings.impact: The four layers are the lesson's main structure and the way each route chooses depth. Readers cannot see where one layer ends and the next begins.
findings.fix: Style lesson H2s as layer bands with typography modifiers on the article (`prose-h2:border-t prose-h2:pt-8 prose-h2:mt-16 prose-h2:text-3xl prose-h2:font-display`). Add an eyebrow such as 'Layer 2 of 4' only if the heading-id remark plugin can tag the layer H2s. Per-layer minute estimates need new data, so leave them out of this change.

findings.title: Lesson frame is four stacked cards, and the article is a card holding more cards
findings.evidence: Breadcrumbs.tsx:29 (`rounded-2xl border border-border/60 bg-card/60`), LessonOrientation.tsx:31 (`rounded-3xl border ... bg-card/80 p-5`), LessonToc.tsx:137 (the below-xl disclosure button) and the article at curriculum/[...slug]/page.tsx:134 (`rounded-3xl border border-border/60 bg-card/70 p-4 ... sm:p-6`) are each bordered cards. measure.out.json: bordered-box depth 5 and 120 bordered boxes in the F1A article. At 1024px, Quick Take starts at about y=690 below four cards (extra/layout/lesson-f1a.1024.default-dark.s0.png). The breadcrumb card also spans the table-of-contents column (to x≈1407) while the orientation card and article stop at x≈1118 (lesson-f1a.desktop.default-dark.s0.png). On mobile the article text is 316px wide against 358px available (metrics.json).
findings.impact: Heavy borders compete with the diagrams, the first screen is mostly frame, and phones lose width.
findings.fix: Remove the article's border, background and padding so prose sits on the page. Render breadcrumbs as a plain text row and the orientation as an unboxed <header> with a bottom rule. Keep the <header> element and `nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"]`, because tests select both. Rule: nested boxes inside a surface use a muted inset with no border.

findings.title: In dark mode mint means body text, heading, label and emphasis at once
findings.where: Site-wide outside lesson prose, worst in default-dark
findings.evidence: globals.css:73 sets dark `--foreground: 165 100% 70%` (#64FFDA), the same value as `--accent` (:75). Every `text-foreground` element is therefore mint: the resources lead paragraph and card descriptions (resources.desktop.default-dark.s0.png), interview question prompts (interview-prep.desktop.default-dark.s1.png), H1s and card titles. Lesson prose is not mint: the typography plugin's prose-invert sets body text to gray-300 and H2 to white (measure.out.json), so H2 is white on lessons, mint on curriculum and resources, and blue (text-primary) on InfoPage pages. In light mode the same roles are dark grey and crimson. A second token set, --blueprint-* hex values (globals.css:8-16), feeds `blueprint.*` colours and .glass-card (globals.css:273). This overlaps the theme lens's foreground finding; keep one owner.
findings.impact: Colour does not tell learners what is clickable, what is a heading and what is important, and full-mint paragraphs are tiring to read.
findings.fix: Add role tokens per theme in globals.css (--heading, --text, --text-muted, --link, --emphasis, --status-*). Set dark --foreground to near-white and keep mint for accent and emphasis. Map the typography plugin's colour variables in tailwind.config.ts to these tokens so prose and non-prose agree. Retire --blueprint-* as .glass-card users move to Card.

findings.title: Interview prep puts 166 questions on one 76,541px page with no way to jump to a level
findings.evidence: metrics.json: docHeight 76,541px at 1440px (85 screens) and 96,950px at 390px (115 screens). The page says '166 questions in 6 banks' (interview-prep.desktop.default-dark.s0.png). The only index is six bank links to `#${bank.anchor}` (interview-prep/page.tsx:245). Each bank then lists Junior, Mid-level, Senior, Staff and Senior staff groups whose H3s already have ids (`group.anchor`, :268), but nothing links to them, and there is no level filter or back-to-top control.
findings.impact: A junior reader has to scroll past staff-level questions, and an expert has to scroll past junior ones. On phones the page is unmanageable.
findings.fix: Under each bank heading, add a row of level links to the existing `group.anchor` ids. Add a level filter at the top (Junior to Senior staff, saved in localStorage) that hides the other levels. Optionally show one bank at a time with the bank links as tabs.

findings.title: Cards, badges and buttons are re-implemented hundreds of times; shared primitives sit unused
findings.evidence: Reproduced with grep over src/**/*.tsx: about 780 class strings combining rounded-(lg|xl|2xl|3xl) with border (about 490 distinct) in about 199 files. ui/Card.tsx is imported by 3 components (DataTypeQuiz, SystemVerilogDataTypesAnimation, StateMachineDesigner) plus src/generated/mdx-component-registry.tsx. components/Card.tsx has no importers. ui/Panel is used only by the MDX registry and components/Card.tsx. ui/Badge is exported from ui/index.ts, but `<Badge` appears nowhere. There are 420 raw `<button` elements in .tsx files. globals.css:273 adds a separate .glass-card.
findings.impact: Each new page or interactive drifts a little further, and there is no single place to fix radius, border or contrast.
findings.fix: Turn ui/Card into a cva component (surface, interactive, inset, callout) on bg-card/border tokens and give ui/Badge the variants code, level, status, filter and count. Delete components/Card.tsx and fold Panel into Card. Migrate page shells first, then interactives as they are touched. Add a scripts/ audit that fails if the ad-hoc rounded+border count rises.

findings.title: Curriculum index: the module list starts 1.8 screens down on desktop and 4 on mobile
findings.evidence: extra/layout/extra.out.json: the 'Modules by tier' H2 is at y=1288 and the first module card at y=1646 at 1440x900. On mobile the first module is at y=3373 of 844 (document 9,839px). Above it are the header, three route cards, the milestone ladder (nine milestone cards inside a card, rendered by RouteChooser) and the placement link (curriculum.desktop.default-dark.s0.png and s1.png).
findings.impact: Returning learners scroll past onboarding every time to reach a module.
findings.fix: In CurriculumOverview, add a 'Jump to modules' link in the header. Make the route cards a compact one-row strip on mobile. Move the milestone ladder below the module list or into a disclosure, since /projects also presents the milestones.

findings.title: Very long lessons have no progress cue, and the TOC's layer groups do not collapse
findings.evidence: metrics docHeight: F1A 36,175px and phasing 48,308px at 1440px; 54,784px for F1A at 390px. The table of contents has 27 entries already nested under the four layers, and at 788px tall it scrolls on its own (measure.out.json; lesson-f1a.desktop.default-dark.s0.png cuts off within the EXPERT items). Layer headings show no completion state.
findings.impact: A 75-minute page feels endless, especially on phones, and a junior reader cannot see where to stop.
findings.fix: In LessonToc, make each existing layer group collapsible, open the active group by default, and add a thin reading-progress bar under the sticky header. Collapsing Push Further for Junior-route learners needs the chosen route to be stored, so treat it as a follow-up.

findings.title: White-alpha surfaces (InfoPage panel, ui/Card, ui/Panel) vanish in light themes
findings.where: InfoPage pages, the few ui/Card and Panel users, and other files with white-alpha classes
findings.evidence: ui/Card.tsx:15, ui/Panel.tsx:12 and InfoPage.tsx:21 hard-code `bg-white/10 border-white/20`. In extra/layout/exercises.desktop.default-light.s0.png the panel edge shows only as a faint shadow on cream. The InfoPage case is fixed by layout-2. ui/Card and Panel have few users (see layout-8).
findings.impact: Grouping is lost in light themes wherever these surfaces appear.
findings.fix: Swap the hard-coded classes for `bg-card border-border` in ui/Card and ui/Panel, then sweep the remaining white-alpha files as they move onto Card variants.

findings.title: Three breadcrumb styles, and some pages have none
findings.where: Lessons, interview prep, expert index, labs, visualization and exercise pages
findings.evidence: Breadcrumbs.tsx:29 renders a carded chevron trail on lessons. interview-prep/page.tsx:215 and curriculum/expert-index/page.tsx:125 each build their own slash trail (interview-prep.desktop.default-dark.s0.png). Labs show only '← Back to lesson' (lab-basics.desktop.default-dark.s0.png). Visualization and exercise pages have none (viz-uvm-phasing, exercises s0).
findings.impact: Learners get a different sense of where they are on each page.
findings.fix: Use one Breadcrumbs component (plain text, chevrons, keeping nav aria-label 'Breadcrumb') through the PageHeader breadcrumb slot on every page below the top level.

findings.title: The lab page has no page header, and its title is 20px
findings.evidence: LabClientPage.tsx:349 sets the H1 to `text-xl`, and metrics.json shows H1 20px and H2 14px for lab-basics. The title sits in the left column above the steps (lab-basics.desktop.default-dark.s0.png). The fallback state at :243 uses `text-3xl`.
findings.impact: The workbench works well, but its title and place in the site are weak next to other pages.
findings.fix: Put a compact header (eyebrow with the module code, a 24-30px H1, the 'Learn it in' link) full width above the two panes, and use one H1 style for both states.

findings.title: Lazy interactives load in a bare 192px placeholder
findings.evidence: LazyMdxInteractive.tsx:150-159: the fallback is an `h-48` box with the plain text 'Loading interactive…'. Most interactives are several times taller (lesson-uvm-phasing s2), so the page shifts when they load and in-page anchors can land in the wrong place. `find src/app -name loading.tsx` returns nothing.
findings.impact: The page jumps when an interactive loads, and the loading state does not look like the frame it becomes.
findings.fix: Render a VisualFrame-like skeleton (eyebrow and title from props) and give each entry in lazy-mdx-interactives.ts an approximate min-height.

findings.title: From xl, the docked course outline repeats the navbar links
findings.evidence: Sidebar.tsx:45-52 defines OUTLINE_QUICK_LINKS, and :271-300 renders them as the 'Quick links' list. They take the bottom ~110px of the outline (lesson-f1a.desktop.default-dark.s0.png, bottom left). The comment at Sidebar.tsx:40-44 says they exist because the navbar shows Labs, Interview prep and Dashboard only from xl. The outline docks from lg, so between 1024 and 1279px the links are not duplicates (the navbar groups them under 'More', lesson-f1a.1024.default-dark.s0.png).
findings.impact: From 1280px wide, duplicate links cost outline space and add noise.
findings.fix: Add `xl:hidden` to the docked outline's Quick links list. Keep it below xl and in the mobile drawer. Do not delete it.

findings.title: The topic template no longer matches the real lesson shape
findings.evidence: docs/topic-template.mdx:8-43 has a bare Quick Take, 'Core Concepts', 'Minimal Example' and '[Quiz](../path-to-quiz) – Coming soon'. Real lessons have 'Words you will meet', VisualFrame visuals, Recap and EXPERT Push Further sections (lesson-f1a s0-s2 and its table of contents).
findings.impact: New lessons written from the template will drift from the 112 live ones.
findings.fix: Rewrite the template from F1A's structure. Keep the six H2s that tests/topicTemplate.spec.ts requires, list the allowed MDX components and VisualFrame usage, and remove the 'Coming soon' items.
